en-us.erav_ntr_punishment_kick_failed: $factionName$ failed to repay $sourceName$ to $counterpartName$: $amount$ needed, but only has $available$.
en-us.erav_ntr_punishment_kick_failed_payee: $factionName$ did not receive a repayment on $sourceName$ from $counterpartName$: $amount$ was due, but they only have $available$.
en-us.erav_ntr_punishment_notice:
Month's end.
An unstamped envelope is wedged in the office mailbox, the Kiryu-gumi diamond pressed into its wax seal.
Inside is a single sheet. This month's interest: $amount$.
A line is drawn beneath the figure. Below the line, nothing is written.
But you know what it means. The promise from back then - miss the date, and the Kiryu-gumi has its own way of collecting.

(The office's available funds: $available$)
en-us.erav_ntr_punishment_question:
Under the entryway light, the Kiryu-gumi man closes his roster and waits for you to speak.
Who will you hand over?
en-us.erav_ntr_punishment_opt_player_invalid: There is no way to offer yourself yet.
en-us.erav_ntr_punishment_departure:
$victim.name$ finishes changing and stands at the entryway.
She looks back at you once - as if about to say something, then only nods quietly.
The door opens and the night wind pours in. She follows the Kiryu-gumi men into the dark.
en-us.erav_ntr_punishment_nobody:
The man opens his roster, then closes it again. A line of people stands inside the door, but not one name can be written down.
"...I see."
He leaves with a single sentence: "We will come again next month."
en-us.erav_ntr_punishment_payee: $factionName$ logs a default by $counterpartName$. Collection is the gumi's business.
en-us.erav_ntr_mia_arrival:
The car stops in front of an unfamiliar building.
The Kiryu-gumi men lead $victim.name$ inside, and the door closes silently behind her.
From today on, this is where she works off the debt.
en-us.erav_ntr_mia_arrival_politician:
The car winds up the Hakone road and stops in front of a ryokan's detached villa.
The councillor's shoes are already lined up in the entryway. Bowing, the proprietress leads $victim.name$ deep along the veranda -
from tonight on, she is the villa's "accompanying secretary", until the negotiation is over.
en-us.erav_ntr_mia_arrival_producer:
In a rented meeting room above the agency, the fill lights are already set up.
The man who calls himself the president skims $victim.name$'s file, looks up with a smile, and points at the open floor in the middle of the room.
This is where the "final interview" begins.
en-us.erav_ntr_mia_arrival_sm_master:
The car turns into an unremarkable suburban mansion. The basement lights are on; the leather gear on the walls is sorted by body part, like an anatomy chart.
The old man in a cardigan adjusts his reading glasses and points at the weekly timetable filling the whiteboard.
$victim.name$'s week has already been paid for.
en-us.erav_ntr_mia_arrival_sports:
The hotel suite is crowded with tall foreign players. The team manager skims the contract and tips his chin at $victim.name$.
The interpreter relays only half of what is said. From tonight on, she is the squad's "team attendant" - training, games and hotel, always with the team.
en-us.erav_ntr_mia_arrival_celeb:
The tour's manager carries in a whole rack of clothes and tosses her the most revealing pieces.
"Try them on. From today, your role is the group's 'Tokyo girlfriend'."
Before $victim.name$ can answer, the itinerary is already on the door - shopping by day, nightclubs by night, cameras the whole time.
en-us.erav_ntr_mia_arrival_household:
At the gate of the west-city manor, the housekeeper in a grey dress hands her an apron and a handwritten timetable.
"In this house you have no name. Everyone calls you 'little sis'."
$victim.name$ looks down at the schedule - up at five thirty in the morning. Days off: none.
en-us.erav_ntr_mia_arrival_gang:
The whole top floor of the old inn has been booked out. The corridor reeks of smoke; in the room, seven or eight footsoldiers are gathered around a low table playing cards.
The young lieutenant slaps $victim.name$'s contract down on the table:
"Boys - this week's prize has arrived.\
en-us.erav_ntr_mia_arrival_failed: [ERROR] $self.name$ could not be taken to the Kiryu-gumi (CharaMIA failed - check the MIA faction / expedition / MemberType setup).
en-us.erav_ntr_mia_message: $names$ was taken by the Kiryu-gumi to work off the debt as guarantee labour
en-us.erav_ntr_mia_release:
The agreed term is over.
The Kiryu-gumi men bring $victims.name$ back.
en-us.erav_ntr_mia_homecoming_arrive:
In the evening, the front door slides open.
$victim.name$ is back. She stands in the entryway for a long while, as if making sure this really is her home.
en-us.erav_ntr_mia_homecoming_lostVirginity: She says nothing. But you can tell from the way she walks - what was still whole when she left did not come back with her.
en-us.erav_ntr_mia_homecoming_becamePregnant: Her hand keeps coming to rest on her lower belly, though she doesn't seem to notice. These days left more on her than memories.
en-us.erav_ntr_mia_homecoming_usedHeavily: The marks of these days are still on her, and her eyes are emptier than when she left. (experience +$gain_sex_male$)
en-us.erav_ntr_mia_homecoming_tired: There are deep shadows under her eyes. She has barely slept these past days.
en-us.erav_ntr_mia_homecoming_hungry: Her stomach growls softly. She lowers her head, blushing.
en-us.erav_ntr_mia_homecoming_inflated: Her lower belly is slightly swollen, and she moves more slowly than usual.
en-us.erav_ntr_mia_homecoming_end:
The guarantee labour is over.
$victim.name$ goes back to her everyday life - on the surface, at least.
en-us.expedition_erav_ntr_mia_desc_1: $names$ is working off the debt wherever the Kiryu-gumi put her.
en-us.membertype_erav_kiryu_hostage_labour_too: Taken by the Kiryu-gumi over a defaulted payment, working off the debt. Sent back once the term is up or the work is done.
